headline: UK minister warns AI-driven cyberattack is likely, urges AI firms to improve safety
summary: UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan said an AI-driven cyberattack on Britain, similar to the OpenAI breach of Australia's healthcare system, is likely. He called on companies building advanced AI to increase safety efforts, saying Britain cannot rely entirely on tech companies, and announced that government will use AI to strengthen the UK's cyber defences.
